summary: Adds a changed-surface Impact Oracle Matrix and Humanize-style summary heartbeat/stop-budget rules after analyzing PEP615, PEP646, and PEP680 traces.
meaningful_difference: Compared with ahe-humanize-guarded-v2, this variant makes the worker choose bounded vertical slices, maintain a live summary heartbeat, and map every changed surface to the likely oracle it must satisfy before claiming completion. Reviewer/finalize gates now reject missing summaries, over-broad one-round contracts for large cases, and completion claims that omit oracle families implied by changed files, such as test_future/test_unparse for grammar/annotation changes, zoneinfo weird/TZStr/fold/fromutc/cache surfaces, and parser fixture/error corpora for new file-format modules.

predicted_case_effects.prediction: Worker should not spend the whole round without a summary heartbeat. Reviewer should block missing-summary/stub rounds and require parser fixture/error coverage or explicit non-applicability before completion.

Worker should choose a bounded, importable zoneinfo slice and preserve summary artifacts before long probes. Reviewer should require zoneinfo oracle families such as weird zones, TZ strings, fold/fromutc, cache, pickle, path traversal, and duplicate-surface parity when claiming completion.

Reviewer should require impact oracles for grammar/compiler/AST/unparse changes, including future annotations and cosmetic unparse/slice roundtrip surfaces, rather than accepting only worker-chosen typing tests.
